LanguageData.RT_CH53E_Vehicle.label: CH-53E Super Stallion
LanguageData.RT_CH53E_Vehicle.description:

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x2, Door Gunner x2, Passenger x24 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
